The README.md file at the root of this project contains a plan for ExpenseCal. The __Feature Plan__ at this README.md file is a list of completed and pending tasks that should be marked by you, the AI Agent. Marking a feature from this plan as completed implies that corresponding E2E tests are implemented to test flows of each feature part.

__!!! We will always discuss is sub item of each feature before implementing it. Resolve all doubts and questions you may have before proceeding to edit any files__.

Follow this development patterns when necessary:

## Package Management

JS & Typescript: pnpm

## Database

Directory: `./database/`

Contains sequelize models used by `./web/`. They are referenced with a `pnpm link`, imported like `@expensecal/database` and initialized as needed with: `initModels` from `./database/models/index.ts`.

The driver is postgresql. Use these database models for any permament storage operation.

Migration files should be automatically generated using the sequelize-cli with the proxy commands defined in `./database/package.json`.

Always keep database models well tested inside organized files in `./database/__tests__/`. Jest is already installed.

ID fields use UUID types, not integers.

Whenever a model is added, remember to put it in the `./database/models/index.ts` file.

## Web

Directory: `./web/`

Contains a NextJS project with @heroui components for Tailwind CSS v4. Routing uses the Apps pattern.

### API

API endpoints are versioned: `./web/app/api/v1/*`.

All API `route.ts` files always have a `types.ts` file with the corresponding Request and Response typings as shown in `./web/app/api/v1/example/`

All API endpoints have a corresponding function in `./web/hooks/useRoutes/useRoutes.tsx` and components that call API endpoints should always use this hook to point to endpoints or pages.

### State Management Controllers

The pattern used by the web project to handle state management is referenced by `./web/context/Example/ExampleContextController.tsx`. Context files are generated by `pnpm plop` — If you need to create a context file, always follow this pattern.

Context controllers are then put in the `Providers` chain at `./web/app/layout.tsx` or at their corresponding `page.tsx` file.

IMPORTANT:

- API calls are always performed inside context controllers using the useRoutes hook to get the right endpoint
- Always use trycatch blocks and display heroui toasts for success and error states
- Whenever a state or a function is created inside a context controller, put it in the `props` list as well as create their typings in their corresponding context `*.types.ts` file

## E2E Testing

Use cucumber statements and a headless browser instance to run Cypress tests through the CLI. Organize these test files in an optimal way.
